why_no_pod: The registered pilot is the F18 six-arm 50-step 4,096-token smoke. Its inputs (F07 rendered curricula, F08 token parity, F10 generated-text nonleakage) do not exist, because F06 (22,400 Qwen transcripts) has not been generated.

The measured F06 smoke projects the full curriculum at about 185 generator hours and about US$228 (exact NF4 batch-8 path, A100 at US$1.23/h). The prepared batch-32 optimization targets at most 60 hours / US$75 and is itself unmeasured. Both exceed the US$3 / 2-hour cap recorded in the amendment.

No six-arm QLoRA trainer exists in the repository (no script implements the frozen recipe or emits frame_internalization_training_smoke_receipt.v2). The F18 receipt therefore cannot be produced yet whatever the budget.

The stage plan forbids self-waiving a missing gate at launch and forbids reduced sequence length or substitute data as a scientific replacement. A pilot on synthetic or truncated data would be a workaround, not the registered pilot.
